sources.snippet: Ye-Xin Lu, Yang Ai, Zhen-Hua Ling In our paper, we proposed MP-SENet: a TF-domain monaural SE model with parallel magnitude and phase spectra denoising. A long-version MP-SENet was extended to the speech denoising, dereverberation, and bandwidth extension tasks. Audio samples can be found at the demo website.

sources.title: GitHub - morikawa-taisuke/MP-SENet
sources.snippet: MP-SENet: A Speech Enhancement Model with Parallel Denoising of Magnitude and Phase Spectra Ye-Xin Lu, Yang Ai, Zhen-Hua Ling In our paper, we proposed MP-SENet: a TF-domain monaural SE model with parallel magnitude and phase spectra denoising. We provide our implementation as open source in this repository.

sources.title: Explicit Estimation of Magnitude and Phase Spectra in Parallel for High ...
sources.snippet: Multi-level loss functions explicitly defined on the magnitude spectra, wrapped phase spectra, and short-time complex spectra are adopted to jointly train the MP-SENet model. A metric discriminator is further employed to compensate for the incomplete correlation between these losses and human auditory perception.
